speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me; I understand you are experiencing unusual behavior and beliefs regarding telepathic communication with animals. To begin our assessment, have you noticed any specific hallucinations, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others cannot?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Capgras delusion associated with schizophrenia spectrum disorder.
